inlines.v: GOD'DESS, noun A female deity; a heathen deity of the female sex. When the daughter of Jupiter presented herself among a crowd of goddesses, she was distinguished by her graceful stature and superior beauty. 1. In the language of love, a woman of superior charms or excellence.
